_about: A client's new address (src/address_change.py): the filled Form AR-11 and a sheet with the EOIR-33's answers and every pending USCIS case to update. No cover letter: the AR-11 is a card mailed on its own (or replaced by the online account's tool), and the EOIR-33 is filed in the EOIR Case Portal.
title: Change of address (AR-11, EOIR-33)
requires_message: The client hasn't been processed yet: process the client first.

address_sheet.title: Change of address: the new address, the EOIR-33's answers, the pending USCIS cases

handwork.text: USCIS recommends the change of address tool in the client's USCIS online account (it updates every case). If it is used, record it: the paper AR-11 isn't needed.
Each pending USCIS case on the sheet: change its address too (online, or by calling the USCIS Contact Center).
A court case: Form EOIR-33 in the EOIR Case Portal within 5 days of the move, served on DHS, then mark the step done on the case page.
